I don't think people quite understand what "Superfund" designation means. Superfund classification isn't handed out to places with a bit of litter, or some leaky storage tanks. It's reserved for the worst of the worst. Areas so polluted that they pose a risk to everything around them. Places that are this bad need to be cleaned up, regardless of who owns it. Anyone who advocates "just leave it alone, it'll be fine" is an idiot of the highest order.

Surprise! It costs money to clean up these industrial waste, and the EPA doesn't have an unlimited budget. Designating something a "superfund" site gives the EPA some teeth to go after the parties responsible for the pollution. 70% of Superfund designated cleanups are paid for this way, and In cases where the responsible parties can't be found or are bankrupt, the funding for cleanup is then allowed to be pulled from the federal "general fund".

So lets ignore the fact that the company that owns this waste dump of a mine has let it sit in this condition for decades without doing anything to correct the situation (And yes, I know that they are not the original owners, but if you buy something like Gold King, it becomes your responsibility to deal with it's problems), that the city of Silverton has itself done nothing to cleanup the waste, and that they've fought since the 90's to prevent the EPA from declaring this a superfund site because "it would damage our tourism". That is literally the definition of short sighted. Living next to a toxic waste dump because cleaning it up would hurt your tourist trade.

What is a Let’s Play?

For those of you that haven’t participated in a let’s play before, pretty much a group of people play through a game or series together and discuss is and have fun with it. You can try different challenge runs and challenges. You can play whatever version of the game you want, stream if you want or just watch a different person’s stream.

We’ll throw up a monthly thread for each game if people want to join in and discuss anything that is happening in the game you are more than welcome to join in. If you want to share videos, your streams or any screen shots from the games you are playing.
